nodes.html:
Arturo Soto is a Mexican photographer, writer and educator. He has published the photobooks "In the Heat" (2018), "A Certain Logic of Expectations" (2021), and "Border Documents" (2025). Soto holds a PhD in Fine Art from the University of Oxford, an MFA in Photography from the School of Visual Arts in New York, an MA in Art History from University College London, and undergraduate degrees in film and photography from the Savannah College of Art and Design. He curated the exhibition Foreign Correspondence at the Architectural Association and participated in the first edition of Forecast Platform at the Haus der Kulturen der Welt. His work has been exhibited internationally and is included in the anthology books "Decolonization and Diversity in Contemporary Photography," "Imaginaria," and the "Subjective Atlas of Mexico." Soto's critical writing has been published in VII Insider, C4 Journal, ASX and Photo-Eye, among others. He lives in Los Angeles.
